setup.effects: Build, apply all additive local migrations, prepare private settings and bootstrap one owner through operator-auth; send an ordinary sign-in to the Base outbox, then stop every temporary process.

dev.effects: Start Vite with assets and HMR, the product synthetic target and private runner on loopback; print readiness after application health and fresh outbox sign-in.

preview.effects: Build and serve fixed production output with the product synthetic target and private runner on loopback; preserve the local owner and durable state; stop after idle timeout or preview --stop.

deploy.effects: Build and provision in the owner Cloudflare account through the pinned rer package, then check health. Dry run validates/builds locally with zero provider requests.

health.effects: Read Cloudflare deployment identity and health for the selected owner account.
health.environmentPolicy: Read-only provider check; application secret values are not required.

verify.effects: Run the complete product verification target without recursive aliases, then serve the production build as rer deploy hosts it (assets behind the Worker, deploy identity bound) and fail naming each built file that does not answer 200 or a /health without the deploy identity. Browser flows need the pinned Playwright Chromium.

export.effects: Write a new private Base integrity archive containing the complete Uptime product payload; exclude credentials and installation authority.

import.effects: After confirmation validate Base integrity and atomically restore complete product/history records into an empty destination, with monitors paused, destinations disabled and notifications quarantined.

definitions.effects: Monitor definition files for the local installation, through the same engine as the console Import view: validate and preview a file (uptime.monitors.json, saved UptimeRobot v3 GET /monitors pages, or an UptimeRobot log export counted as history) without writing; apply exactly the previewed plan digest as one batch with new monitors paused; export current definitions to a new file; list batches and undo one. Never enables a monitor, issues a heartbeat token, schedules a notification or touches a destination. Pass validate|preview|apply|export|batches|undo and their flags; stop dev or preview first.

artifact-prepare.effects: Build clean exact source without credentials and package an inert Worker, assets and migrations.
artifact-prepare.environmentPolicy: Isolated credential-free Linux job. Use only the declared preparation inputs and job plumbing; the preparation home and artifact path are private and outside the checkout.

artifact-deploy.effects: Provision Worker, D1 and Cron from an independently verified artifact.

conditionalEnvironment.when: Required for a fresh deployment or when the corresponding named secret is absent at the provider. Existing opaque secrets are preserved; identical-artifact receipt readback needs no secret values.

artifact-deploy.environmentPolicy: Separately reviewed credential-bearing controller with no install or build. Invoke directly with Node through the declared package command.

artifact-health.effects: Read provider deployment, schema and Cron state and verify served deployment identity.
artifact-health.environmentPolicy: Read-only credential-bearing controller with existing private receipt; application secret values are not needed. Invoke directly with Node through the declared package command.

install.effects: Frozen dependency installation; no setup, global tool change or deployment.

build.effects: Build production Worker/assets with all private local settings excluded and restored exactly.

reset.effects: After explicit confirmation remove canonical local state, private settings, installer state and CLI bookkeeping only.

release.effects: Base release producer, verification and publication checks; no push or deployment.

outbox.effects: Print the running local Base outbox URL; request ordinary sign-in only with an owner email; open browser only when explicitly requested.

doctor.effects: Read-only tool, pin, local settings and state diagnostics; no provider request.

describe.effects: Read-only command flags, aliases, pins and effects.

check.effects: Read-only operations and first-party contract validation; no credentials required.

authentication: Base operator-auth magic-link owner sessions and one-time setup. Local sign-in links use the development outbox.

health.meaning: D1 readiness and deployment identity, not target health, runner operation, mail delivery, notification delivery or recipient acceptance.

environmentInspection: The local check inspects aggregate declared names, source guidance and the enabled hosted sign-in mail loop. It performs no provider request, does not read private saved settings, does not select a command, and does not validate command-specific runtime behavior. An empty environment lists every declared source; dummy values only check descriptor completeness.
